sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fromMaybe function, which provides a default value when something is Nothing
sketches.resonance: When you reach for what was there and find Nothing, you must decide what to put in its place — and the default you choose reveals everything.
sketches.draft:
missing :: a -> Maybe a -> a
missing whatYouBecome Nothing = whatYouBecome
missing _ (Just whoYouWere) = whoYouWere

sketches.mechanism: LEFT JOIN producing NULL for unmatched rows — one table has records the other never will
sketches.resonance: Two lives joined on a shared key, but every row from one side finds no match on the other — presence beside absence, carried forward as NULL.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
  days.moment,
  together.you
FROM days
LEFT JOIN together
  ON days.moment = together.moment
WHERE together.you IS NULL

sketches.mechanism: A process that sends a message to a pid that has already terminated — the message is silently dropped, never delivered, never errored
sketches.resonance: You can keep speaking to someone who is gone; the language will not stop you, and nothing will answer.
sketches.draft:
gone() ->
  Pid = spawn(fun() -> ok end),
  timer:sleep(100),
  Pid ! i_miss_you,
  Pid ! are_you_there,
  Pid ! please.
